response.overview: Elliot’s sole dream is to make his dad proud by crafting the perfect cup of coffee. However, the pressures of running the family café and his relentless pursuit of perfection lead him to overlook the valuable lessons his father imparts. When his dad unexpectedly passes away, Elliot is compelled to face the impact of his perfectionism head-on, forcing him to reevaluate his approach to both coffee and life.
response.title: Beyond The Counter
